source: opencode db; allowlisted providerID/modelID/finish fields from five latest assistant metadata records
query: SELECT json_extract(data,'$.providerID') AS provider, json_extract(data,'$.modelID') AS model, json_extract(data,'$.finish') AS finish FROM message WHERE json_extract(data,'$.role')='assistant' ORDER BY time_created DESC LIMIT 5
session_binding: Recent records corroborate harness model label; query does not uniquely bind the active session
